modes.input: signed-positive int32 LE byte length <= 33554432, UTF-8 JSON, stdin EOF required
modes.output: same length-prefixed PascalCase JSON, numeric Core enums, exit 0 if response written (including Job.State=Failed)
modes.extraDiagnostic: Probe.Failure is a static classification only; no archive path, raw input or library exception text

modes.input: 64-byte ZXE2 config followed by exact ZXR2 replies
modes.stdout: 64-byte ZIP2 header + payload; sequences start at 0; 64KiB max data
modes.itemId: central-directory ordinal + 1 in first four LE bytes, remaining 12 bytes zero
modes.termination: EndJob Completed + stdout EOF + exit 0 all required; failure emits no successful EndJob

exitCodes.0: normal protocol completion; inspect v1 Job status
exitCodes.12: integrity error; library may not expose EOF vs format cause
exitCodes.15: observed UnexpectedEof only, not inferred from a generic ZIP error
exitCodes.17: extraction rejects duplicate names before zip crate metadata can collapse them

supported.names: ASCII or flagged strict UTF-8, <= 4096 raw bytes and 1024 UTF-16 code units

policyDifferences: v1 uses strict ZIP32 structural preflight and local/central consistency, unlike the older permissive listing implementation
v1 preserves duplicate names, full count and central-directory ordinal IDs; v2 still rejects exact duplicate names before emitting any item
metadata read budget counts actual preflight reads for v1 and also crate indexing/consistency reads for v2; the same cumulative 2 MiB cap applies
v1 processed budget charges input length once as the C# listing does; v2 charges actual reads and decoded output, read counts depend on library
ZIP library CRC failures may be generic InvalidData; do not relabel all of them as actual EOF or a precise parser phase
first Deflate stream with trailing packed garbage or another stream requires explicit comparison against frozen C# fixtures; no backend acceptance claim is made before execution
safetyBoundary: no output path or archive path accepted by worker
host retains independent index, OS path/link checks, CRC, actual output budget, collision, publication and cleanup
list success does not verify payload CRC or filesystem safety
v2 output can be staged before CRC completion; host must never publish without EOF, exit 0 and successful independent verification
no progress or cancel-request control message is added
deadline checks are cooperative between I/O and codec calls; external host timeout and owned-process termination remain required
process separation is not an OS memory/CPU/permission sandbox
Windows FileDispositionInfo cleanup hang remains unresolved

stdin cannot be checked for EOF after last v2 range reply because host keeps reply pipe open until worker exit; exact reply headers and byte counts are checked and stdout EOF is produced by process exit

metadataAccounting.logicalStructure: ZIP32 entry count, names, extras, local/central and packed boundaries are structural guards, not read counters.
metadataAccounting.readScope: EOCD full count and cumulative declared sizes count every duplicate. Metadata cap remains 2097152 actual read bytes; listing no longer performs redundant ZipArchive indexing reads.
metadataAccounting.disabledAt: open() disables metadata_mode after checking all by_index_data records and before extract() calls archive.by_index. Later item-open metadata rereads are not counted against MAX_METADATA.
metadataAccounting.remainingLimits: v2 later reads still charge processed bytes and obey Remote request/range caps; decoded output charges processed/output separately. v1 list_accounting charges input length once, not each repeated read.
metadataAccounting.failureLatch: Rejecting a metadata request larger than the remaining allowance latches the shared Budget before inner Read. Smaller retries, metadata disable, shared Sources and frame completion cannot clear it.
metadataAccounting.evidence: Direct source regression only; zip 9.5 catching this error and completing successfully has not been observed. No demonstrated total-budget bypass is claimed.
